speaker: richard_field
text: Will? Richard Field. From my own shop, where there is a gap on the shelf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Holinshed is in daily use and in excellent health.

speaker: richard_field
text: It is in a playhouse man's chamber with a cat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cat reads only the second volume.

speaker: richard_field
text: Sunday. Dinner. After sermon. Jacqueline has a hen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After sermon. I will come. I will not bring the chronicle.

speaker: richard_field
text: Bring the comedy, if the book-keeper will loose it. I cannot in conscience come to hear it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll bring it. Thou'lt read it with the door shut.

speaker: richard_field
text: With the door shut. God keep thee.
